data.title: Guangdong Yueyun Signs RMB26,243,316 Photovoltaic EPC Contract
data.description:
Guangdong Yueyun Transportation Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3399) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Guangdong Yueyun Transportation Company Limited is a transportation company with a New Energy Branch involved in expressway service-zone projects. On 19 November 2026, the branch signed a RMB26,243,316 tax-inclusive photovoltaic engineering, procurement and construction contract with Lulutong for the GF1 section of a distributed photovoltaic project at Guangdong Provincial GCGC Expressway service zones.

Phase I covers 21 pairs of service zones, with GF1 involving 11 pairs, and the contract includes photovoltaic design, equipment procurement, installation, testing, commissioning and connection to the company’s intelligent management system. data.description:

data.title: Abbisko Presents Preclinical Findings for Selective CDK4 Inhibitor
data.description:
Abbisko Cayman Limited ( (HK:2256) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Abbisko Therapeutics presented at 2026 ENA a study selected for the Late-Breaking Abstracts program, detailing preclinical findings for ABSK192 in HR+/HER2- breast cancer models. The compound showed potent CDK4 inhibition with more than 70-fold selectivity over CDK6, antiproliferative activity regardless of PIK3CA mutation status, G1 arrest and robust single-agent antitumor activity in vivo.

Combination experiments found synergistic activity with endocrine, PI3K and CDK2 inhibitors in vitro; combinations with fulvestrant, imlunestrant or GDC-0077 produced enhanced antitumor efficacy and tumor-volume regression in vivo. Abbisko said the findings support ABSK192’s development potential as a selective CDK4 inhibitor and provide a preclinical rationale for single-agent and combination regimens.

data.title: HUTCHMED Presents Preclinical HMPL-A830 Data at Cancer Research Conference
data.description:

HUTCHMED develops oncology drug candidates, including antibody-targeted therapy conjugates (ATTCs) that pair monoclonal antibodies with small-molecule inhibitor payloads for solid tumors. Its ATTC approach combines targeted therapies with dual mechanisms of action.

data.title: HBM Holdings Announces NMPA Acceptance of LET003 IND Application
data.description:
HBM Holdings Ltd. ( (HK:2142) ) has issued an announcement.

HBM Holdings develops monoclonal antibody drug candidates, including LET003 for overweight or obesity, using its Hu-mAtrIx™ AI platform.

China’s NMPA accepted the IND application for LET003, the company’s first AI-enabled drug candidate and a dual ACVR2A/ACVR2B blocker. In preclinical studies, LET003 showed superior pharmacokinetic characteristics versus multiple competitor molecules and, when combined with semaglutide, enhanced fat reduction while preserving lean mass.
